appDescription.message: Place calls from web pages through your own FreePBX or Asterisk server.

rememberSecretLabel.message: Remember the API secret on this device

pageContextLabel.message: Send a sanitized page URL with calls

pageContextHint.message: Off by default. Query strings, fragments and URL credentials are removed.

pageAccessEnabled.message: Enabled for web pages. Phone-like text and tel: links can be clicked.

pageAccessDisabled.message: Disabled. Quick call and right-click selection still work.

errorTimeout.message: The PBX did not respond in time.

errorNotConfigured.message: Complete and save the PBX connection settings first.

errorInvalidDirectory.message: The PBX returned an invalid extension directory.

errorHttpsRequired.message: The PBX URL must use HTTPS.

errorIncompleteConnection.message: Enter the PBX URL, API credentials and protocol.

errorPbxPermissionDenied.message: Permission to connect to this PBX host was not granted.

errorPagePermissionDenied.message: Permission to detect phone numbers on pages was not granted.

errorReconnectRequired.message: Connect again after changing the PBX settings.

errorChooseExtension.message: Choose an extension returned by the PBX.

contentUpdated.message: The extension was updated. Reload the page and try again.

aboutLead.message: Place calls from Chrome through your own FreePBX or Asterisk server.

aboutStepOne.message: Your administrator installs the PHP 8.x backend on your PBX.

aboutStepTwo.message: You enter the PBX HTTPS URL and your personal API credentials.

aboutStepThree.message: The extension asks the PBX to ring your phone, then connects the destination.

aboutNoRelay.message: There is no UniLoud cloud relay. Call details go only to the PBX URL you configure.

aboutPrivacyOne.message: Automatic page phone detection is optional and requires a separate permission.

aboutPrivacyTwo.message: Page URL context is off by default and removes query strings, fragments and credentials.

aboutPrivacyThree.message: Your API secret is restricted to trusted extension pages; you can keep it session-only.

aboutSetupText.message: Open the extension popup, expand Connection settings, connect to your PBX and select your extension.
